datasheet.date: 2026-02-10 (FT series catalog pages 1-4; usage pages 5-11 dated 10-May-24 and 1-Sep-25)

absolute_maximum.conditions: rated voltage; peak of DC plus superposed ripple must not exceed rated voltage (p8); use at or below rated voltage also for transients and pulses (p7)
polarized: do not apply a reverse voltage

recommended_operating.conditions: I <= 0.01 CV (uA) after 2 minutes, with C = 470 uF and V = 25 V
rated voltage at +105 C; after test cap change within +/-30 %, tan delta <= 200 % of initial limit, leakage within initial limit
size code F standard product, L +/-0.3
estimated service life not longer than 15 years (sealing rubber)

pins.notes: Positive terminal. Datasheet gives no pin numbers; polarity marking is on the negative side. Numbered 1 (positive) as in the KiCad C_Polarized symbol.
Negative terminal, marked with the negative polarity marking (black band on the case top). Numbered 2 (negative) as in the KiCad C_Polarized symbol.

layout_notes.text: Standard product land pattern for size code F (phi 8 x 10.2 L): a = 3.1 mm, b = 4.0 mm, c = 2.0 mm; a larger 'a' may prevent a proper back fillet.
Do not place a heating element on the back of the capacitor; in general a 10 C drop in temperature doubles the life.
Parallel capacitors: use the same part number and avoid unequal trace impedances so ripple current does not concentrate on one capacitor. Do not use capacitors in series.
On double-sided boards, do not route a wiring pattern directly underneath the capacitor (electrolyte leakage concern).
Reflow: high temperature lead-free reflow, profile class (6) for this part; see the reflow profile page.

gaps: No surge voltage rating given in the product pages; p8 only says do not exceed surge voltage for short periods.
No impedance at low temperature (-25/-40 C) ratio given in the extracted pages.
Ripple current temperature correction (below 105 C) not found in the FT pages.
Life equation (p8): T1 = upper category temperature plus temperature rise at rated ripple current; that rise is not given, so T1, T2 and DT must be supplied by the user.
Leakage limit 117.5 uA is computed from the datasheet formula 0.01 CV (p1) with C = 470 uF, V = 25 V.
Reflow profile page (class 6) not located in this PDF (11 pages); 'Reflow (6)' column on p4 refers to a page not included.
Datasheet gives no pin numbers; '+' and '-' used as labels, map to the symbol by polarity.
Vibration-proof variant (EEEFT1E471AV) dimensions differ (p2); this sheet covers the standard product AP.
Usage pages 5-11 carry different dates (10-May-24, 1-Sep-25) from the catalog pages 1-4 (10-Feb-26).
